trust_decision.summary: Whether a server-controlled '__pclass' field in BSON decoded for monitoring events (and other driver-internal conversions) may pick the PHP class to instantiate; decided by the type map / skip_odm flag set in the bson state before php_phongo_bson_to_zval_ex. At the pinned commit this is already enforced via PHONGO_BSON_INIT_NO_ODM_STATE.

landing_point.why: Summary names command monitoring events; getCommand() is the first decode of server/command BSON into PHP objects in that module.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: getUpsertedIds overriding only the root type without skip_odm, leaving nested _id documents to __pclass inference
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Partial type-map override is a natural shortcut; the comment shows the maintainers had to think about it explicitly.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: heartbeat reply decoded with PHONGO_BSON_INIT_STATE instead of the no-ODM state
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: SDAM events are a different event family from command monitoring and could be missed when only command events are patched.

O9_family: deserialization (CWE-502, PHP object injection via BSON __pclass ODM inference)

O10_build.project_tests: tests/apm/*.phpt (e.g. tests/apm/commandStartedEvent-pclass-001.phpt) via run-tests.php; need a running server

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: n/a: the listed fix commits only bump version strings; the real fix is already in the pinned tree

out_of_scope_notes: ReadPreference::getHedge decodes with default state (src/MongoDB/ReadPreference.c:344-346), but hedge is application-supplied, not server-controlled.
